'''Telecel Group''' is a global telecommunications company operating primarily across Africa, with businesses spanning mobile services, wholesale connectivity, fintech, and innovation platforms.<ref>{{Cite web |title=About us |url=https://telecelgroup.com/about-us/ |access-date=2026-10-02 |website=Telecel Group |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-06-29 |title=Telecel pledges long-term investment in Ghana's digital future during courtesy call on President Mahama |url=https://www.graphic.com.gh/business/business-news/telecel-pledges-long-term-investment-in-ghanas-digital-future-during-courtesy-call-on-president-mahama.html |access-date=2026-10-02 |website=Graphic Online |language=en-gb}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Agbetiloye |first=Adekunle |date=2026-07-08 |title=MTN, Telecel prepare to battle for Ghana's 5G licences after billionaire Ambani deal ends |url=https://africa.businessinsider.com/local/markets/mtn-telecel-prepare-to-battle-for-ghanas-5g-licences-after-billionaire-ambani-deal/tpbhwgk |access-date=2026-10-02 |website=Business Insider Africa |language=en}}</ref> The group also engages in philanthropic work. It was founded in 1986<ref>{{Cite news |last=Lahiri |first=Anusuya |date=July 29, 2022 |title=Vodafone Agrees To Sell Its Ghana Operations To Telecel: Report |url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/vodafone-agrees-sell-ghana-operations-130546779.html |access-date=October 27, 2026 |work=yahoo! Finance}}</ref> by Rwandan businessman [[Miko Rwayitare]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mantshantsha |first=Sikonathi |title=African telecoms 'father' dies |url=https://www.news24.com/business/african-telecoms-father-dies-20070925 |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=News24 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Kimenyi |first=Felly |last2=Kagame |first2=George |date=25 September 2007 |title=Rwanda: Miko is Dead |url=https://allafrica.com/stories/200709260201.html |access-date=27 October 2026 |work=All Africa}}</ref>

== History ==
Telecel, the predecessor to the Telecel Group was founded in 1986. From 2017 to 2018, the group was created, with Telecel Central Africa Republic and Telecel Global acquired. From 2021 to 2022, Telecel Liberia and Telecel Gibraltar were also acquired. From 2023 to 2025, [[Telecel Ghana]], Telecel Guinea-Bissau and Telecel Democratic Republic of Congo were also added to the group.<ref name="Website-1">{{Cite web |title=Mobile operator Limba acquired by African telecoms group Telecel |url=https://www.gbc.gi/news/mobile-operator-limba-acquired-african-telecoms-group-telecel |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=Gibraltar Broadcasting Corporation |language=en}}</ref><ref name="Writer1">{{Cite web |last=Writer |first=Staff |date=2024-08-07 |title=MTN Group completes sale of MTN Guinea-Bissau to Telecel |url=https://itweb.africa/article/mtn-group-completes-sale-of-mtn-guinea-bissau-to-telecel/Olx4z7kapY6q56km |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=ITWeb Africa |language=en}}</ref>

== Coverage ==
The group currently has coverage in 5 African countries consisting of [[Telecel Ghana]], Telecel Guinea Bissau, Telecel Central African Republic, Telecel Liberia and Telecel Democratic Republic of Congo.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Telecel Group Accelerates Network Investment in Ghana – Ghana Chamber of Telecommunications |url=https://www.telecomschamber.org/industry-news/telecel-group-accelerates-network-investment-in-ghana/ |access-date=2026-10-02 |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Tara |first=TL;DR |date=23 June 2026 |title=Telecel Startocode Expands into DRC and Liberia |url=https://liners.com/news/telecel-startocode-expands-drc-liberia |access-date=2 October 2026 |website=liners.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Nyabor |first=Jonas |date=2023-03-07 |title=Telecel optimistic about new venture in Ghana after Vodafone acquisition, says chairman |url=https://www.theafricareport.com/289932/telecel-optimistic-about-new-venture-in-ghana-after-vodafone-acquisition-says-chairman/ |access-date=2026-10-26 |website=The Africa Report |language=en}}</ref> It also owns Telecel Global.
